title: Business-Wrap template pack
description: A requirements-document layout as data. engine/srs/compose.mjs lays the neutral requirements model onto it; engine/srs/packs.mjs validatePack() enforces the rules this schema cannot express (ar/en pairs of equal length, known generators, referenced columns). Validate with: node engine/srs/cli.mjs validate <dir>.

gen.description: The generator that fills the section from the model. «stories» expands into one section per people's stage (plus the output story).

cols.description: integrations only: the fields printed, in order

columns.description: integrations only: the columns key (default: the value of `of`)

paragraphs.description: prose only: template paragraphs; {name} {entity} {customer} {request} {channels} {output} are filled in

whenEmpty.description: question (default): an empty section becomes a named open question; none: the template states «none» (only where absence is a valid answer)

codeFormat.description: how the looked-up code prints, e.g. ORG-SRS-{code}-01 (a profile's codeFormat wins)

outputFromApproval.description: an approved end implies an output named after the process (e-service style)

signatureSteps.description: regex over system-step names that mean the output is signed

systemTrace.description: which sections take up system steps whose names match

askCaptions.description: default true: derived action captions are listed as one open question

control.description: default control-table values ({ar,en} each): documentType, classification, status, reviewCycle, preparedBy, owner

glossary.description: the pack's words: customer, request, requests, customerChannel, staffChannel, outputDefault … (same keys in both languages)

glossaryTable.description: rows of the «glossary» generator: {ar: {term: definition}, en: {...}}

questionsInDocument.description: keep a «questions» section inside the document (default false: questions go to open-questions.md)

storyContract.description: false: stories carry no retrieved-data / display-criteria table

families.description: derived rules carry their family in the code (BR-REJECT-01, BR-EDIT-01, BR-SLA-01 …)

backOfficeOnly.description: no staff stage → the rules section prints «none»

struckFamilies.description: rule families never printed (matched on the code)

when.description: conditions joined by &, ! negates: staff, partners, serial, reroute, phone, recipients, payment

stageTasks.description: dictionary rows every staff stage carries (the in-stage tasks, never actions): {ar: [[7 cells]], en: [...]}
